content.about: Tuvalu is a small Polynesian nation of nine islands. It is threatened by rising seas. Its ".tv" domain earns income. It is one of the least visited countries.

standout.text: Tuvalu is one of the lowest-lying countries, highest point about 4.6 m.

didYouKnow: Its highest point is about 4.6 m.
It is one of the smallest countries.
